caveats:
Two lake features, ‘Lago De Amatitlan [GT0100]’ and ‘Lago De Atitlan [GT0700]’, are associated with administrative level 1 features but form their own [P-code GTxx00] administrative level 2 features.

This COD-AB excludes the UN recognized sovereign territory of Belize. Users are responsible for the way they depict the Guatemala / Belize border and territories.
dataset_source: Coordinadora Nacional Para La Reducción De Desastres
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Dataset: Downloaded by OCHA from [Coordinadora Nacional Para La Reducción De Desastres](https://conred.gob.gt), small topological errors fixed, and features P-coded.

The 'gtm_admbdl_ALL_OCHA_2018' line shapefile and geodatabase class contains a field identifying the neighboring countries.

VETTED, CONFIGURED, and LIVE SERVICES PROVIDED by ITOS.

notes:
Guatemala administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 22   
- Admin 2: 342

- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness
